name: OpenMausBot
description: Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use
one_liner: A chat app where every contact in your sidebar is a real AI agent with its own personality and its own cloud computer, so you text it a task and watch it actually get done.
buyer: A solo consultant or small agency that wants a 'team of AI employees' without paying for a closed subscription product or giving up control of their data and model choice.
business_use_cases: A solo consultant sets up a roster of specialized bots (research assistant, scheduler, inbox triage) and runs their back office through chat, paying only for model API calls they already have.
An agency white-labels this open-source app to resell as a 'team of AI employees' product to small business clients, charging for setup and hosting.
A privacy-conscious law firm or healthcare practice runs its agents on its own infrastructure instead of trusting a closed cloud product with client data.

money_ideas.idea: Managed hosting and support subscription for a white-labeled version
One-off setup and configuration service bundling a few useful bot personas for small businesses

steal_this: Package three or four useful bot personas (scheduler, research, inbox triage) as a pre-configured bundle and sell it as an 'AI office in a box' one-off setup for solo consultants.
